identity.what_it_is: A beach at Kollam city in Kerala, India, also known as Mahatma Gandhi Beach, fronting the Arabian Sea and adjoined by Mahatma Gandhi Park.
identity.where: Thamarakulam, Kollam city, Kerala, India, near Kollam Port and the Tangasseri lighthouse/breakwater.

spike_candidates.statement: Kollam Beach, called one of Kerala's deadliest, got an IIT Madras geo-tube redesign plan in 2023 after 57 drownings in 7 years.
spike_candidates.tension: A beach marketed for sunsets and weddings is officially the state's most dangerous stretch of coast, deep and turbulent close to shore.

spike_candidates.statement: Wikipedia can't agree what year Kollam's landmark Mahatma Gandhi Park opened: 1961 in English and Tamil, 1967 in Malayalam.
spike_candidates.tension: The beach's own local-language Wikipedia disagrees with the English and Tamil versions on the founding date of its central attraction.

spike_candidates.statement: A 2014 marine aquarium billed as 'first of its kind in Kerala' was due to open by December 2014, but no source confirms it ever opened.
spike_candidates.tension: A flagship attraction announced with fanfare a decade-plus ago has no dated follow-up proving it was finished or is running today.

facts.fact: Kollam Beach, also known as Mahatma Gandhi Beach, is a beach at Kollam city in the Indian state of Kerala.
facts.quote: kollam beach, also known as mahatma gandhi beach, is a beach at kollam city in the indian state of kerala.

facts.fact: The beach measures over 2,300 metres in length.
facts.quote: length 2,300+ m

facts.fact: The beach is located in Thamarakulam, Kollam, India.
facts.quote: location thamarakulam, kollam, india

facts.fact: The nearest bus station is 3.1 km away, the railway station 2.4 km, and the ferry terminal 3.1 km.
facts.quote: access bus station - 3.1 m, railway station - 2.4 km, ferry terminal - 3.1 km

facts.fact: The beach is patrolled by lifeguards and carries a high hazard rating.
facts.quote: patrolled by lifeguards hazard rating high

facts.fact: Kollam Beach is described as the first 'beach wedding destination' in Kerala.
facts.quote: kollam beach is the first 'beach wedding destination' in kerala.

facts.fact: Mahatma Gandhi Park at the beach was inaugurated on 1 January 1961 by then vice president of India Zakir Husain, per the English Wikipedia article.
facts.quote: mahatma gandhi park, which was inaugurated on 1 january 1961 by the then vice president of india, zakir husain.

facts.fact: Lifeguards were stationed at the beach starting in 2005, and as of July 2015 Kollam was one of only three south Kerala beaches (with Kovalam and Varkala) with lifeguard outposts.
facts.quote: lifeguards were stationed at the beach from 2005. as of july 2015 [ update ] kovalam, kollam is one among the three beaches in south kerala with lifeguard outposts.

facts.fact: Kollam Port is one of the oldest and most important ports for the international cashew trade on the Malabar Coast.
facts.quote: kollam port is one of the oldest and most important ports for the international cashew trade on the malabar coast of the arabian sea.

facts.fact: As of 2025, Kollam Port is the third largest port in Kerala, after Trivandrum Port and Cochin Port.
facts.quote: as of 2025 [ update ], kollam port is the third largest port in kerala after trivandrum port and cochin port.

facts.fact: Kollam was once a favourite settlement of the Portuguese, Dutch and English in succession before Indian independence.
facts.quote: kollam was once a favourite settlement of the portuguese, the dutch and the english in succession before independence.

facts.fact: Kollam's port is protected by the Tangasseri breakwater, which extends about 1.1 miles (1.8 km) south-southeast of Tangasseri Point.
facts.quote: the port is protected by the tangasseri breakwater, extending about 1.1 miles (1.8 km) south-south east of tangasseri point.

facts.fact: Construction of a marine aquarium at Kollam Beach, the first of its kind in Kerala, started on 22 June 2014.
facts.quote: on 22 june 2014, construction work started on a marine aquarium at kollam beach, which was first of its kind in the state of kerala.

facts.fact: The Harbour Engineering Department built the aquarium on the beach's eastern side on behalf of Kollam Municipal Corporation.
facts.quote: the harbour engineering department is constructing the aquarium at the eastern side of the beach on behalf of kollam municipal corporation.

facts.fact: The aquarium's foundation stone was laid in March 2014, with completion expected by December 2014.
facts.quote: the foundation stone for the project was laid in march and is expected to complete by december 2014.

facts.fact: The planned aquarium was designed as a single-storey building with 40 large tanks holding a diverse collection of marine life.
facts.quote: it will be a single storey aquarium with 40 large tanks to hold a diverse collection of marine life

facts.fact: The 144-foot (44 m) Tangasseri Lighthouse, built in 1902, is a major landmark at the beach.
facts.quote: the 144-foot (44 m) tangasseri lighthouse built in 1902 is a major landmark at the beach.

facts.fact: Ruins of Portuguese/Dutch forts and 18th-century churches remain near the port as mementoes of colonial rule.
facts.quote: ruins of portuguese / dutch forts and 18th-century churches near the port remain as a memento of the portuguese and dutch rule of the area.

facts.fact: Events associated with Kollam include the President's Trophy Boat Race and Kollam Pooram.
facts.quote: president's trophy boat race kollam pooram

facts.fact: The English Wikipedia article on Kollam Beach was last edited on 6 August 2026.
facts.quote: this page was last edited on 6 august 2026, at 15:12 (utc).

facts.fact: Malayalam Wikipedia states the international-standard Mahatma Gandhi Park was inaugurated on 1 January 1967 by then vice president Zakir Husain — a different year than the English article.
facts.quote: അന്താരാഷ്ട്ര നിലവാരത്തിലുള്ള മഹാത്മാഗാന്ധി പാർക്ക് 1967 ജനുവരി 1ന് അന്നത്തെ ഉപരാഷ്ട്രപതിയായിരുന്ന സക്കീർ ഹുസൈനാണ് ഉദ്ഘാടനം ചെയ്തത്.

facts.fact: Tamil Wikipedia corroborates the 1961 date, stating the Indian vice president Zakir Husain inaugurated the park on 1 January 1961.
facts.quote: இந்தியத் துணை குடியரசுத் தலைவர் சாகீர் உசேன், 1961 ஆம் ஆண்டு சனவரி 1, அன்று இப்பூங்காவைத் தொடங்கி வைத்தார்.

facts.fact: Tamil Wikipedia confirms lifeguards were posted from 2005, and that as of July 2015 only Kovalam, Varkala and Kollam had lifeguard facilities among south Kerala beaches.
facts.quote: 2005 ஆம் ஆண்டு முதல் இக்கடற்கரையில் இவர்கள் நியமிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளனர். சூலை 2015 ஆம் ஆண்டு நிலவரப்படி கோவளம், வார்கலா மற்றும் கொல்லம் கடற்கரைகள் மட்டுமே நீச்சல் புறக்காவல் வசதி பெற்றிருக்கும் தென் கேரளக் கடற்கரைகளாகும்.

facts.fact: Tamil Wikipedia states that per a 2010 estimate, Kollam Port was the second largest port after Kochi Port — conflicting with the English article's 2025 'third largest' claim.
facts.quote: 2010 ஆம் ஆண்டு மதிப்பீட்டின்படி கொச்சித் துறைமுகத்திற்கு அடுத்ததாக இரண்டாவது பெரிய துறைமுகம் கொல்லம் துறைமுகமாகும்.

facts.fact: Incredible India lists the nearest airport as Trivandrum International Airport (TRV) and the nearest railway station as Kollam Junction Railway Station (QLN).
facts.quote: nearest airport: thivandrum international airport (trv), thiruvananthapuram nearest railway station: kollam junction railway station (qln)

facts.fact: Local legend holds that Lord Parasurama, the sixth incarnation of Vishnu, threw his axe into the sea to reclaim the coastal land of Kerala, including Kollam.
facts.quote: one famous legend is about lord parasurama, the sixth reincarnation of lord vishnu. it's believed that he threw his axe into the sea to reclaim the land, which is the coastal region of kerala, kollam included.

facts.fact: The Portuguese were the first European power to start a settlement at Kollam, in the 16th century, followed by the Dutch and British.
facts.quote: the portuguese were the pioneers, and in the 16th century, they started a settlement at kollam.

facts.fact: Ashtamudi Lake, popular for backwaters and houseboat cruises, is about a 10-minute drive from Kollam Beach.
facts.quote: ashtamudi lake is popular among tourists for its backwaters and houseboat cruises and is a mere 10-minute drive from the beach.

facts.fact: The Hindu reported in January 2023 that Kollam Beach, considered one of the deadliest beaches in the state, would be developed into a safe and tourist-friendly destination.
facts.quote: the kollam beach, considered to be one of the deadliest beaches in the state, will be soon developed into a safe and tourist-friendly destination.
facts.source_title: Kollam beach to be developed as a safe and tourist-friendly destination - The Hindu

facts.fact: 57 people drowned in the sea at Kollam Beach over the preceding seven years, driving the safety-upgrade project.
facts.quote: 57 persons have drowned in the sea during the last seven years.
facts.source_title: Kollam beach to be developed as a safe and tourist-friendly destination - The Hindu

facts.fact: A team from IIT Madras presented a detailed project report for the sustainable development of Kollam Beach, including new water sports.
facts.quote: a team from iit madras on friday presented a detailed project report, which also includes the introduction of water spots, for the sustainable development of the beach.
facts.source_title: Kollam beach to be developed as a safe and tourist-friendly destination - The Hindu

facts.fact: The depth of Kollam Beach near the coast is four metres, with very turbulent waves, making it riskier than other Kerala beaches.
facts.quote: the depth of the kollam beach near the coast is four metres and the waves are very turbulent.
facts.source_title: Kollam beach to be developed as a safe and tourist-friendly destination - The Hindu

facts.fact: The 2023 safety project plans to increase the beach's length by around one kilometre while decreasing its depth, using groynes and geo-tubes.
facts.quote: after the completion of the project, the length of the kollam beach will increase by around one kilometre while the depth will decrease.
facts.source_title: Kollam beach to be developed as a safe and tourist-friendly destination - The Hindu

facts.fact: Event managers Jo and Company, from Thiruvananthapuram, say they conducted the first beach wedding held at Kollam.
facts.quote: owners of jo and company, the event managers from thiruvananthapuram, who conducted the wedding claim that this was the first time that a beach wedding was held at kollam.
facts.source_title: Kollam beach turned into dream wedding destination - The New Indian Express

facts.fact: Under a 2011 five-year maintenance contract, entry to Mahatma Gandhi Park cost Rs. 5 per person, with parking fees of Rs. 5 for two-wheelers and Rs. 10 for cars (beach entry itself stayed free).
facts.quote: the entry fee has fixed at rs. 5 per person. the parking fee will be rs. 5 for two wheelers and rs. 10 for cars.
facts.source_title: Mayor to inaugurate spruced up MG park - The Hindu

facts.fact: At its original inauguration the park complex included a deer park and an aquarium, but lack of maintenance later let it deteriorate into a haven for anti-socials before its 2011 refurbishment.
facts.quote: at the time, the complex comprised a deer park and an aquarium. but lack of maintenance resulted in the park deteriorating and turning into a haven for anti-socials.
facts.source_title: Mayor to inaugurate spruced up MG park - The Hindu

facts.fact: In June 2005, Kerala Chief Minister Oommen Chandy expressed concern over rising drowning accidents at Kollam Beach after multiple deaths that week.
facts.quote: the chief minister, oommen chandy, has expressed concern over the increasing number of drowning accidents on kollam beach.
facts.source_title: Move to post lifeguards on Kollam beach - The Hindu (via Wayback Machine)

facts.fact: Following the 2005 drownings, police were to be posted on the beach to warn visitors away from the water, with warning boards ordered as well.
facts.quote: police personnel would be posted on the beach from thursday to warn visitors against venturing into the waters.
facts.source_title: Move to post lifeguards on Kollam beach - The Hindu (via Wayback Machine)

facts.fact: Kollam Beach is about 3 km from the city center, roughly a 10-minute auto-rickshaw or taxi ride.
facts.quote: kollam beach is about 3 km away from the city center. you can take an auto-rickshaw or a taxi to reach it in about 10 minutes.
facts.source_title: Kollam Beach: A Complete Guide - Tripoto

facts.fact: There is no entry fee for Kollam Beach itself, though visitors may pay for activities like boating, surfing, fishing, or the adventure park.
facts.quote: there is no entry fee for kollam beach. however, you might have to pay for some activities or attractions such as boating, surfing, fishing, or visiting the adventure park.
facts.source_title: Kollam Beach: A Complete Guide - Tripoto

facts.fact: Seafood specialties available near Kollam Beach include karimeen fry, prawn curry, fish moilee, and crab masala.
facts.quote: some of the specialties include karimeen fry, prawn curry, fish molee, and crab masala.
facts.source_title: Kollam Beach: A Complete Guide - Tripoto

facts.fact: Visitors are advised to avoid swimming or surfing in deep or rough waters, especially during high tide or the monsoon season.
facts.quote: avoid swimming or surfing in deep or rough waters, especially during high tide or monsoon season.
facts.source_title: Kollam Beach: A Complete Guide - Tripoto

facts.fact: Tripoto's quick-facts panel places Kollam Beach 66 km from Trivandrum International Airport.
facts.quote: 3 km from kollam railway station, 66 km from trivandrum international airport
facts.source_title: Kollam Beach: A Complete Guide - Tripoto

facts.fact: Tripoto's own body text instead states the airport is about 70 km away, contradicting its quick-facts panel.
facts.quote: the nearest airport to kollam beach is trivandrum international airport, which is about 70 km away.
facts.source_title: Kollam Beach: A Complete Guide - Tripoto

recency.newest_item: The Hindu's 27 January 2023 report that Kollam Corporation and IIT Madras would redesign the beach with groynes and geo-tubes after 57 drownings in seven years, since which no harvested source reports whether the project was built or completed.

dead_ends: Current (2024-2026) status of the 2023 IIT Madras groyne/geo-tube safety project — whether it was funded, built, or completed is not covered by any harvested source.
Whether the 2014 marine aquarium (announced complete by December 2014) ever opened or is still operating today.

Named restaurants, beach shacks, or confirmed current businesses with prices — Tripoto names hotels (The Raviz Resort & Spa, Ashtamudi Villas, Nani Hotel, Fragrant Nature Backwater Resort) but as a third-party guide, not the businesses' own sites or dated press, so none qualify as confirmed-operating business facts.
Exact current lifeguard staffing numbers, shift patterns, or equipment at the outpost.
Current bus/train/ferry fares and any recent (post-2016) beach wedding volume or vendor names beyond the single 2016 Jo and Company story.

conflicts: Mahatma Gandhi Park inauguration year: English Wikipedia (F07) and Tamil Wikipedia (F22) say 1 January 1961; Malayalam Wikipedia (F21) says 1967.

Kollam Port's rank among Kerala ports: English Wikipedia (F10) says third largest as of 2025 (after Trivandrum and Cochin); Tamil Wikipedia (F24) says second largest per a 2010 estimate (after Kochi).
Distance to Trivandrum International Airport: Tripoto's own quick-facts panel says 66 km (F43) while its body text says about 70 km (F44).
